meta.name: Court of Gold
meta.description: Go behind the scenes with the top medal contenders in men's basketball as they battle for gold and glory at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After failing to medal at the 2023 World Cup, Team USA rallies a star-studded roster for the 2024 Olympic Games — but their global competition is steep.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As Canada pressures Greece, France and rising rookie Victor Wembanyama take on Brazil. Kevin Durant cements his legacy on the court against Serbia.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Steve Kerr reflects on his Olympic journey and the challenges of coaching an MVP-stacked team. For Serbia, Yugoslavia's basketball legacy looms large.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Bam Adebayo finds inspiration in his mother. France and Canada meet in a quarterfinal match where Evan Fournier thrills the host country crowd.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: It's win or go home for the US and Serbia as they clash in the semifinals, where a stunning momentum shift turns the fourth quarter into a nail-biter.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Bubbly flows as Serbia secures bronze. With gold on the line, the US sees double-digit leads come and go against France — until Steph Curry takes over.

meta.slogan: The bigger the stage, the bigger the glory.
